instruction: Configure Chrome to block images from loading on all websites in site settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate to Chrome site settings and disable images for all sites. Evaluator verifies by checking the Chrome Preferences file profile.default_content_setting_values.images field (2=block). Custom getter function get_chrome_images_setting__9945e6ef returns 'block' or 'allow'.
